title.en: Amending Section 1 of Executive Order No. 993 Increasing the Daily Subsistance Allowance of Uniformed Members of Integrated National Police to Twelve Pesos (P12.00) Per Day

text.en:
The daily subsistence allowance of twelve pesos (P12.00) for uniformed members of the Integrated
National Police provided in Section 1, Executive Order No. 993 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 1. The daily subsistence allowance provided in Letter of Implementation No. 133 for uniformed
members of the Integrated National Police is hereby increased from eight pesos (P8.00) to twelve pesos

This order shall take effect January 1, 1985.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 30th day of January, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
eighty-five.
